terms_note: Not live-verified: built from xAI's documentation (read 2026-11-02), no recorded call. Prices are the per-image fees on the xAI models page. Editing also bills each input image, which the docs give no price for. The host of returned image URLs is not documented, so the adapter asks for b64_json and allows .x.ai only as a fallback for URL downloads. Check Paradox's and Steam's rules for AI-generated mod assets before publishing.

models.notes: The model xAI recommends. $0.04 per generated image. Output size is chosen by aspect_ratio and resolution (1k, 1.5k, 2k), not by pixels. Up to 5 input images for edits. No native transparency is documented.
